title: Normalized morphism into recorded qcqs compact support
statement: Under the field, coefficient, finite-type and compactification hypotheses of [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-integral-derived-reduction, def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], there is a unique natural morphism from the actual completed proper/open compact-support functor on integral constructible inputs to the recorded integral action [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action]. Its positive finite scalar reduction, followed by the recorded chosen projection adjunct, is the actual proper/open coefficient mate, in the canonical finiteReductionIso and finiteImageIso coordinates. No invertibility of this natural morphism is asserted. This is the simultaneous normalization of all objects and all levels.
